feature_or_feature_group: PortWatch Daily Calls & Cargo (8 ground truth cols)
source: IMF PortWatch / UN Global Platform AIS
publication_or_availability_evidence: UN Global Platform AIS processing latency is empirically 24-48 hours. Official IMF PortWatch platform updates on a 2-day rolling delay.
current_rule: T - 2 days lag required for operational forecasting deployment
leakage_risk: Low if lagged by >= 2 days; High if contemporaneous day-t actuals are ingested without a dedicated real-time AIS receiver at the port.
recommended_handling: In baseline sequence forecasters, lag PortWatch inputs by 2 days, or explicitly document an operational assumption of local real-time AIS feed ingestion.

publication_or_availability_evidence: Constructed as backward-looking rolling means; inherits the 2-day reporting lag of raw PortWatch calls.
leakage_risk: None (no forward leakage); Critical multicollinearity risk (r > 0.995).
recommended_handling: Safe for historical forecasting. Retain roll7_mean as primary predictor; encode 14d and 30d as difference residuals (roll7 - roll30) or drop.

publication_or_availability_evidence: By mathematical definition, these values occur strictly after prediction time t.
current_rule: Prohibited from predictor feature tensor X
leakage_risk: Fatal target leakage if included in feature matrix X.
recommended_handling: Zero-tolerance exclusion from feature tensor X. Evaluate strictly in supervised loss function Y.

observation_time: Deterministic date t and future t+k
publication_or_availability_evidence: Calendar dates are mathematically known in advance with zero uncertainty.
current_rule: Safe for both encoder (lookback) and decoder (forecast horizon)
recommended_handling: Safe to supply to both encoder and decoder layers in Seq2Seq, Transformer, and GBDT architectures.

publication_or_availability_evidence: ECMWF releases daily ERA5T (near-real-time) with a 5-day publication latency. Final consolidated ERA5 reanalysis has a 2-3 month latency.
current_rule: T - 5 days lag; requires NWP forecast proxy at deployment
leakage_risk: High if contemporaneous reanalysis is treated as known at prediction time.
recommended_handling: Historical evaluation may use ERA5 lagged by >= 5 days. For forward 7-day deployment, models must be conditioned on operational numerical weather predictions (IFS/GFS), not reanalysis actuals.

feature_or_feature_group: NOAA Storm Events & Gale Shocks (12 cols)
publication_or_availability_evidence: Official NCEI Storm Events data is published in monthly batches with a 60-90 day latency. Property damage estimates undergo retrospective post-disaster audits.
current_rule: Audited damage quarantined; real-time warning flags used as proxy
leakage_risk: Fatal for property damage USD; Low for binary active storm flags if sourced from National Hurricane Center real-time advisories.
recommended_handling: Exclude noaa_storm_damage_property_sum from prediction inputs. Condition models strictly on active storm/warning indicators (noaa_is_storm_active_50km).

publication_or_availability_evidence: CRED compiles and audits disaster records retrospectively with a publication lag of 3 to 6 months post-event. Impact figures (deaths, affected, damages) are revised over years.
current_rule: Retrospective context only; audited mortality/damage quarantined
leakage_risk: Fatal if audited mortality or monetary losses are used contemporaneously.
recommended_handling: Do not pass audited total_damage_usd or total_deaths to forward models. Use only active occurrence flags (emdat_macro_disaster_active) as qualitative stress indicators.

publication_or_availability_evidence: BTS publishes annual Port Performance reports 12 to 18 months after year-end (e.g. 2021 report published in late 2022).
current_rule: Baseline year t_base strictly less than current year t_eval
leakage_risk: Moderate if annual baseline is forward-filled into the current calendar year before publication.
recommended_handling: Enforce strict 1-year lag on BTS baselines (e.g., use 2019 baseline for 2021 operations). Treat as static structural node capacity features, not dynamic temporal drivers.

feature_or_feature_group: ADB Port Traffic Database (19 Asian/Global Ports)
publication_or_availability_evidence: Published as a research report and database release post-2022.
current_rule: External benchmark asset only; not in primary daily panel
recommended_handling: Use strictly for external calibration of vessel size bottlenecks and anchorage waiting time surges. Do not interpolate into the primary daily panel.

feature_or_feature_group: Zenodo US AIS Monthly Vessel Dwell (5 US Ports)
current_rule: External benchmark asset only; not in primary daily panel
recommended_handling: Maintain strict firewall: Zenodo measures multi-cargo harbor residence time, which does not co-vary consistently with container turnaround (r = -0.1294 at NY/NJ). Do not use as ground truth container dwell.

publication_or_availability_evidence: Static research dataset released via Mendeley Data.
current_rule: Micro-level process prior only; not joined daily
recommended_handling: Use exclusively as micro-level domain guidance for customs channel delay dynamics (Red channel +84% dwell). Do not attempt to merge into global macro models.
